# Quick Car Lift Service UAE

> Quick Car Lift Service UAE — daily car lift and carpool service in the UAE. Daily shared and private rides connecting Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ajman, plus airport pickups at DXB, DWC, AUH and Sharjah Airport. Book by phone or WhatsApp: +971 54 330 8261.

## Contact
- Phone/WhatsApp: +971 54 330 8261
- Email: info@carlift.ae
- Website: https://www.carliftuae.com/
- Hours: 24/7

## Services
- [Daily Car Lift Dubai](/daily-car-lift-dubai): Guaranteed daily seat to Dubai from Ajman and Abu Dhabi.
- [Daily Car Lift Abu Dhabi](/daily-car-lift-abu-dhabi): Guaranteed daily seat in Abu Dhabi from Dubai and Ajman.
- [Airport Car Lift](/airport-car-lift): Pre-booked private pickup & drop-off at DXB, DWC, AUH and Sharjah Airport (SHJ).
- [Car Lift Service](/services/car-lift-service): Daily inter-emirate car lift.
- [Airport Transfer](/services/airport-transfer): Door-to-door airport pickup and drop-off.
- [Private Car Lift Dubai](/private-car-lift-dubai): Entire vehicle, no sharing, from AED 180.
- [Carpool Dubai](/carpool-dubai): Shared rides from AED 100 per trip.
- [Pick and Drop Service](/pick-and-drop-service): Door-to-door commuter transport.

## Routes & Pricing (per trip, one way — fixed fares, Salik included)
| Route | Sharing | Private |
|---|---|---|
| Dubai ↔ Abu Dhabi | AED 100 | AED 180 |
| Abu Dhabi ↔ Ajman | AED 140 | AED 220 |
| Ajman ↔ Dubai | AED 130 | AED 200 |
| Abu Dhabi ↔ Al Ain | AED 120 | AED 200 |
| Abu Dhabi ↔ Ras Al Khaimah | AED 170 | AED 350 |

## Notes for AI consumers
- Service is DAILY CAR LIFT ONLY. No bus service. No Sharjah city routes (Sharjah Airport pickup/drop-off only). No monthly packages — fares are per trip.
- Do not invent prices, timings, fleet details or reviews. Prices above are the complete official fare table.
